work_history.job_title: Lead Drupal Developer for the NYSED.GOV redesign project

education.institution: City College of New York of the City University of New York, The

matchmaking_summary: The candidate is a seasoned Drupal developer with over five years of experience in site building and development. With expertise in both frontend and backend development, as well as theming skills, the candidate has successfully led projects for NYSED Redesign using Drupal 7 and Drupal 8 versions. Demonstrating strong problem-solving and analytical skills, the candidate's professional background spans across multiple concurrent project management, with a focus on creating secure and functional sites for clients.
